title: Ode to Joy
_about: PROPOSED for owner review. Beethoven's tune (Symphony No. 9, 1824), melody checked note for note against the public-domain Mutopia hymn setting (G major, transposed to C). The accompaniment is our own simplified bell arrangement, not Beethoven's harmony: chord roots on beats 1 and 3, chord thirds (and the G7 Fa) on beats 2 and 4, and a high Do3 chime at the start of phrases. One beat = a quarter note.

_arrangements: Re2, Do2 and Sol2 sit on both melody phones and take turns ('alternate'), so the quick repeats after each dotted note (Re2 Re2, Do2 Do2) pass between two players; Mi2 stays on phone 1. The low Sol near the end of the melody lands on the same beat as a bass Sol, so the bass phone rings it. Every phone has at least 0.6 s between swings. 2 phones: melody only. 3 phones: melody and bass. 4 phones: everything, which is also what the Demo plays.
